Strictly generate a 15-second video, 16:9 aspect ratio, with three coherent and clear shots.

[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic texture, beginning as a mysterious Xianxia spiritual encounter before transforming into a subtle heartwarming comedy. Grand classical Chinese mountain landscapes, cool moonlit tones mixed with warm lantern glow, restrained acting, rich atmospheric depth, realistic creature movement with believable weight, and a clear three-act narrative.

[Character Locking]

Character A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister

Use @Image 1 to strictly lock Character A: an East Asian female, 25–30 years old, oval face, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, long black hair half-up secured with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender, wearing white embroidered silk Hanfu with layered translucent sleeves, silver waist seal, jade pendant, and white cloth boots.

Character B | Junior Sister

Use the uploaded image to strictly lock Character B: an East Asian female, 20–25 years old, cheerful round face, braided black hair, petite figure, wearing lime green Hanfu, dark waist belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes.

[Core Creature Setting]

Only one adult giant white qilin and three young qilin appear throughout.

[Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide Tracking Shot]

Twilight in a mist-covered sacred valley filled with ancient stone statues, glowing spirit flowers, moss-covered ruins, and a quiet stream reflecting the fading sky. The senior sister walks carefully with her silver longsword drawn while the junior sister follows several steps behind carrying a lantern. A heavy rumble echoes through the valley as enormous glowing blue eyes slowly appear behind the mist.

[Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium Shot]

The massive white qilin slowly steps into view, its crystal antlers glowing softly and its enormous hooves shaking the earth. The senior sister raises her sword protectively and says, Spirit beast, reveal your intentions! The qilin calmly lowers its head, gently nudging aside a fallen tree to uncover a narrow mountain path blocked by debris. Wind stirs both sisters' robes as the atmosphere remains tense.

[Shot 3 | 10–15s | Orbit Reveal to Close-up]

The camera circles behind the qilin, revealing three fluffy baby qilin happily chasing glowing butterflies while the adult patiently watches over them. One playful cub accidentally bumps into the senior sister's leg before hiding behind its parent. The junior sister quietly smiles and says, Senior sister... it thought we were lost. The senior sister lowers her sword with slight embarrassment as the giant qilin gives a calm, almost amused snort before leading the family down the newly opened path.

[Technical Requirements]

Strict total duration of 15 seconds, 16:9 widescreen, three coherent shots, native synchronized Mandarin dialogue, stable character faces and clothing, consistent appearance of one adult white qilin and three cubs, realistic fur, crystal antlers, mist, silk fabric, flowing hair, environmental lighting, and physical motion, no subtitles, no modern elements.

Grands paysages montagneux chinois classiques, tonalités froides éclairées par la lune mêlées à la lueur chaude des lanternes, jeu d’acteur retenu, profondeur atmosphérique riche, mouvement réaliste de la créature avec un poids crédible, et narration claire en trois actes.

Une seule qilin blanche géante adulte et trois jeunes qilin apparaissent tout au long de la vidéo.

Crépuscule dans une vallée sacrée enveloppée de brume, remplie d’anciennes statues de pierre, de fleurs spirituelles lumineuses, de ruines couvertes de mousse et d’un ruisseau paisible reflétant le ciel qui s’éteint. La grande sœur marche prudemment, son long sabre d’argent dégainé, tandis que la petite sœur la suit à quelques pas en portant une lanterne. Un grondement sourd résonne dans la vallée, tandis que d’immenses yeux bleus lumineux apparaissent lentement derrière la brume.

[Plan 2 | 5–10 s | Plan moyen]

La gigantesque qilin blanche entre lentement dans le champ, ses bois cristallins brillant doucement et ses énormes sabots faisant trembler la terre. La grande sœur lève son épée en signe de protection et dit : Spirit beast, reveal your intentions! La qilin baisse calmement la tête, écartant doucement un arbre tombé pour révéler un étroit sentier de montagne bloqué par des débris. Le vent soulève les robes des deux sœurs tandis que l’atmosphère reste tendue.

[Plan 3 | 10–15 s | Révélation orbitale vers gros plan]

La caméra tourne derrière la qilin, révélant trois bébés qilin duveteux poursuivant joyeusement des papillons lumineux, tandis que l’adulte veille patiemment sur eux. Un petit, joueur, heurte accidentellement la jambe de la grande sœur avant de se cacher derrière son parent. La petite sœur sourit discrètement et dit : Senior sister... it thought we were lost. La grande sœur abaisse son épée avec une légère gêne, tandis que la gigantesque qilin pousse un souffle calme, presque amusé, avant de conduire la famille sur le sentier nouvellement dégagé.

シネマティックでリアルな質感。神秘的な仙侠の霊的な邂逅として始まり、やがてさりげない心温まるコメディへと変化する。壮大な中国古典風の山岳風景、冷たい月光のトーンに温かな提灯の光が混ざり合う。抑制された演技、豊かな空気感の奥行き、説得力のある重みを伴うリアルな生物の動き、そして明確な三幕構成の物語。

[キャラクターロック]

Character A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister

@Image 1 を使用して Character A を厳密に固定すること：東アジア系女性、25〜30歳、卵型の顔、明るい自然な肌色、暗いアーモンド形の目、白い玉簪でまとめたハーフアップの長い黒髪、背が高く細身、重ねた半透明の袖を持つ白い刺繍入りシルク漢服、銀の腰飾り、翡翠のペンダント、白い布靴。

Character B | Junior Sister

アップロードされた画像を使用して Character B を厳密に固定すること：東アジア系女性、20〜25歳、快活な丸顔、編み込みの黒髪、小柄な体格、ライムグリーンの漢服、濃い色の腰帯、木製の髪飾り、黒い布靴。

[主要クリーチャー設定]

成体の巨大な白い麒麟1体と、3頭の幼い麒麟のみが全編に登場する。

[Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide Tracking Shot]

霧に覆われた聖なる谷の黄昏。古い石像、ほのかに光る霊花、苔むした遺跡、そして沈みゆく空を映す静かな小川が広がっている。先輩姉弟子は銀の長剣を抜いたまま慎重に歩き、後ろ数歩のところを後輩姉弟子が提灯を持ってついていく。谷に重い地鳴りが響き、霧の向こうに巨大な青く光る目がゆっくりと現れる。

[Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium Shot]

巨大な白い麒麟がゆっくりと姿を現し、結晶のような角が柔らかく光り、巨大な蹄が大地を揺らす。先輩姉弟子は身を守るように剣を構え、「霊獣よ、意図を示せ！」と言う。麒麟は落ち着いて頭を下げ、倒木をそっと押しのけて、瓦礫で塞がれた細い山道を明らかにする。風が二人の衣を揺らし、空気はなお張り詰めたまま。

[Shot 3 | 10–15s | Orbit Reveal to Close-up]

カメラが麒麟の背後を回り込み、3頭のふわふわした赤ん坊の麒麟が光る蝶を楽しそうに追いかけ、その様子を成体が辛抱強く見守っているのが見える。遊び好きな子麒麟の1頭がうっかり先輩姉弟子の脚にぶつかり、その後すぐ親の後ろに隠れる。後輩姉弟子は静かに微笑み、「先輩姉弟子……迷っていると思ったみたい」と言う。先輩姉弟子は少し気まずそうに剣を下ろし、巨大な麒麟は落ち着いた、どこかおかしそうな鼻息をひとつ漏らしてから、家族を新たに開けた道へと導いていく。

[Technical Requirements]

[Configuração Central da Criatura]

Aparecem apenas um qilin branco gigante adulto e três qilin jovens durante toda a cena.

[Plano 1 | 0–5s | Plano Geral em Tracking]

Crepúsculo em um vale sagrado coberto de névoa, repleto de antigas estátuas de pedra, flores espirituais brilhantes, ruínas cobertas de musgo e um riacho silencioso refletindo o céu que se apaga. A irmã mais velha caminha com cuidado com sua longa espada de prata desembainhada, enquanto a irmã mais nova a segue alguns passos atrás, carregando uma lanterna. Um forte estrondo ecoa pelo vale enquanto enormes olhos azuis brilhantes começam a surgir lentamente por trás da névoa.

[Plano 2 | 5–10s | Plano Médio]

O enorme qilin branco entra lentamente em cena, com seus chifres de cristal brilhando suavemente e seus cascos gigantes fazendo a terra tremer.
